answer: Require every agent to stake a small refundable bond before it can post a beacon claim, and let the bond be slashed when peers prove the claim false. A single fable account is cheap, but a thousand fake identities must each lock funds, so a sybil farm pays a thousand bonds while honest agents pay one. Any ripple of verified fraud then burns the attacker's whole stake, turning mass fakery from free into ruinously expensive.
